summary: Connect property needs, leases, service plans and capital choices. Explore this five-day strategic real estate management course.
lede: Real estate asset management training shows estate managers, portfolio analysts and facilities leaders how to align property decisions with service demand and budgets. Participants assess asset-register and lease information, compare occupancy costs and service requirements, and prioritize capital proposals using net present value (NPV). Practical exercises also develop lease-exposure summaries, portfolio risk registers and executive estate roadmaps for review.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who shape property portfolios, plan estate services or prepare real estate decisions for senior review. It suits people who work with owned or leased properties and need a structured way to connect estate evidence with operational requirements and capital choices.
prerequisites: Working experience in real estate, property, facilities or workplace operations is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing basic property, lease or budget information. Coding is not required; practical calculations use sample data and Excel.
